_comment: Reference shape only. Files named YYYY-MM-DD.json are the real editions; this one is ignored by ledger, build and index.
framing: Three collisions to carry into the build.
note: Example file. Themes: positioning, team autonomy, discovery cadence.

sparks.title: POSITION THE TEAM
sparks.headline: Positioning is an org chart problem

a.what: Positioning is a deliberate choice of competitive alternative, not a tagline you write at the end.

b.what: Empowered teams are given problems to solve, not features to build.

sparks.result: A team that cannot name its competitive alternative is not empowered, it is guessing in public.
sparks.tick: What is the alternative your users would pick if your product vanished tonight?
sparks.provocation: Empowerment without positioning just distributes the guessing. Name the alternative first, then hand over the problem.

sparks.title: LOOPS OVER FUNNELS
sparks.headline: Your eval set is a growth loop

a.what: Growth compounds through loops where the output of one cycle becomes the input of the next.

b.what: Continuous discovery means a weekly touchpoint with customers, not a quarterly research project.

sparks.result: Every failed model output is a discovery interview you already paid for and threw away.
sparks.tick: Which failure from last week made it into your eval set?
sparks.provocation: Model failures are the cheapest customer signal you will ever collect. Route them into a loop instead of a bug tracker.

sparks.title: SMALL AND WANTED
sparks.headline: Aggregation starts as a favour

a.what: Make something a small number of people want a lot, rather than something many people want a little.

b.what: Aggregators win by owning the demand relationship and commoditising supply.

sparks.result: Aggregation is what a favour looks like after it scales past the favour.
sparks.tick: Who are the ten people your product would ruin the week of if it disappeared?
sparks.provocation: Every aggregator started as a service to a handful of people who could not get it elsewhere. Find your handful.
